note: Explicit exemptions for digits that appear in step prose and are not derived data. Keep this list short and specific: an entry is a promise that the number can never go out of step with anything else on the page. A plain count is better spelled out ("six wedges") than allowlisted. Match is exact on file + stepId + text.

entries.reason: The grade of a flour, not a quantity. Italian flours are named by how finely they are milled — 00 is the finest — and the name cannot drift because it is not derived from anything.
